pets.name: Milo
pets.description: Milo is an energetic, friendly boy who loves playing fetch and gets along great with children. Fully vaccinated and house-trained.

pets.name: Luna
pets.description: Luna is a calm and affectionate cat who loves sunny windowsills and quiet cuddles. She is spayed and microchipped.

pets.name: Rocky
pets.description: Rocky is loyal, highly intelligent, and protective. He knows basic obedience commands and would thrive with an active owner.
